Removes vault secrets whose source TCA records have been deleted. Helps maintain vault hygiene and prevent accumulation of unused encrypted data.
Keep orphans for this many days before deletion. Set to 0 to delete immediately. Default: 7 days.
Optional: Only check secrets from this specific table. Leave empty to check all tables.

Publishes the current audit log chain tip to the enabled external audit sinks. Each run records outside the database that the chain had reached a given sequence, which is what makes a later full audit table reset detectable. The scheduling interval is the window an attacker could still hide.

Verifies the audit log hash chain and compares it against the last published chain-tip anchor. Reports hash mismatches, uid gaps, table resets and epoch downgrades, and dispatches an integrity alert event for SIEM or notification listeners.

When enabled, the task only fails on tamper evidence (hash mismatch, uid gap, table reset, epoch downgrade) and treats configuration or delivery findings (no external sink, sink failure) as warnings. Useful while external sinks are still being rolled out, so a pending integration does not keep the task permanently red and mask a real alarm.
